notes.title: Emily is Away
notes.content:
[h3]Jump back in to the Emily series today with Emily is Away <3![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/978460/Emily_is_Away_3/][b]Available now on Steam![/b][/url]

Emily <3 is a brand new game on an entirely new platform! Sign into Facenook today for wall posts, poke wars, note surveys and more! Chat with your friends Emily, Evelyn and now Mat! Navigate your way through the branching narrative and see if your senior year ends in heartbreak or true love! In short: It's complicated.

[previewyoutube=4XCCbNgaWaA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Longevity Update[/h2]
Along with the new game, Emily is Away is also getting a longevity update. This includes an engine upgrade and new builds for Mac OSX users! 

Thank you everyone for the continued support of my silly little games. It means the world to me!

notes.title: Emily Is Away
notes.content:
Social struggles media simulator Emily Is Away <3 has officially launched some more teen drama for you to live through. Like the previous Emily Is Away games, it ferries you back to the days of social media past. It's Facebook circa 2008 this time, where you'll navigate the trials and tribulations of your senior year through "Facenook" messenger and wall posts and pokes and playlists and more. It's an excellent recreation. Is it warm in here or was I actually sweating while talking to my fake friends?

Read more

notes.title: Priceless Play 23 November 2019
notes.content:
I am floored by the sheer number of indie games available at the moment. If you look, there’s a game about nearly everything under the sun — multipalyer kissing, packing up an old apartment, baseball lesbians, haunted empty MMO servers, Bitsy poems about the sea, and alien art exhibitions. If you have only ten seconds to spare, five minutes, or two hours, there’s a free game for that. We are spoiled for thoughtful, considered, clever, and weird self-published games.

I consider it a great honour and a privilege to delve into the depths of itch.io (or Steam, or weird flash game aggregate websites, or wherever) to bring you fresh, free indie titles week after week. So, if you were looking for a swatch of indie games to take up your weekend, this post has 20 games tucked away in it.

notes.title: Emily Is Away
notes.content:
Kyle Seeley’s Emily Is Away series feel like interactive time capsules. An all-too-vivid recollection of what social media felt like, and how it affected the lives of people back in the day. In the upcoming third instalment Emily Is Away <3, Players have to say goodbye to AOL Instant Messenger and begin their descent into the only slightly invasive (at the time) vortex that is Facebook, circa 2008. Expect drama, multiple-choice dialogues and several possible endings once more when it launches. There’s no launch date yet, but you can see the debut trailer below.

notes.title: Instant message em up Emily Is Away Too is out now
notes.content:
Oh God. Emily Is Away Too [official site], a game about instant messaging, is giving me horrible flashbacks to when I used MSN Messenger in school and used random 50 Cent lyrics as my screen names on rotation. I even put the little music note icons at either end like quote marks. I was so cool. *Shivers*.

Anyway, the game is a throwback to your teen drama days and a spiritual successor to Emily Is Away, which captured the passive aggressiveness and subtlety of IM language superbly. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Emily Is Away Too Is Another Jab At That 00s AOL Kid in You
notes.content: Emily Is Away was a huge callback for me. It instantly took me back to the days where I would languish on AOL Instant Messenger and wait for my role-playing buddies to sign on so I could pretend I was talking to Dragon Ball Z’s Vegeta. So, despite my issues with the wishy-washy dialogue in some instances, I’m glad to see its getting a sequel in the form of Emily Is Away Too [official site]. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Trading Cards and Future Plans
notes.content:
[b]Trading Cards[/b]
Trading Cards have been added! Unfortunately because the game is free-to-play they require a minimum purchase amount. If there was a switch to give all players cards I certainly would press it. Check out more specific details on your 'Badges' page.

[b]Future Plans[/b]
Currently I'm working on iOS and Android versions of Emily hopefully to be released in the coming month or so. Still no updates on a potential sequel but it's something I'm definitely considering.

And seriously, thank you all for playing! I am so grateful for the support the steam community has shown me. We're closing in on a million downloads so that's very exciting!

notes.title: Achievements and Community Icons
notes.content:
[b]Achievements[/b]
Achievements have been added! There are 20 in all and can be achieved by playing the game or by using the secret icons.

[b]Community Icons[/b]
Another round of Community Icons have been implemented. Some are shout-outs to lets players of Emily is Away [i](Thanks Dodger, Squeezie, SSundee and PewDiePie!)[/i] The others were suggested by the community! Anything you'd like to see? Check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/417860/discussions/0/492378265892826522/]this thread[/url].

If there's any other suggestions you have for further updates let me know! And if you want to support the game and future development you can [url=http://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/417860/browse/?filter=all]Donate Here[/url].

As always, thank you all for playing! I am so grateful for the support the steam community has shown this game, you're all amazing!

notes.title: Donations and Future Updates
notes.content:
Thank you so much for checking out the game! Your support and enthusiasm has been nothing short of amazing. 

[b][url=store.steampowered.com/itemstore/417860]Donations[/url][/b]
You can donate now by using the [url=store.steampowered.com/itemstore/417860]Item Store![/url] Trading cards are still in the works.

[b][url=steamcommunity.com/app/417860/discussions/0/492378265890261440/]Bugs and Fixes[/url][/b]
Just released a new update to fix some minor issues and a missing build error for Linux users. As always, if you're still running into things please check out [url=steamcommunity.com/app/417860/discussions/0/492378265890261440/]this thread[/url] for temporary solutions or to report anything new.

[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/417860/discussions/0/492378265892826522/]Unlockable Icons[/url][/b]
I'd like to have another update with more unlockable icons! If you have any requests for future icons you'd like to see in the game please [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/417860/discussions/0/492378265892826522/]let me know here![/url] If you didn't know about these icons you can check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=559027135]the guide[/url] that outlines how to get them. 

[b]Achievements[/b]
Steam works has been integrated, so achievements are next on my to do list!

Thanks again for your support, you're all incredible!
